The Sandwich Variance of the Coefficients

Source: R/sandwich.R
sandwich_vcov.Rd

Computes \(c\,V_b B V_b\) for the coordinates in cols, with \(V_b\) the inverse penalized information that vcov.StatmodFit() has built, \(B\) the sum over observations (or over clusters) of the outer product of the scores, and \(c\) the correction of the type.

Usage

sandwich_vcov(
  fit,
  design,
  Vb,
  cols,
  sw,
  expected = FALSE,
  emethod = NULL,
  lev_info = NULL
)

Arguments

fit

The StatmodFit().

design

The design of the fit.

Vb

The inverse penalized information over the coordinates cols.

cols

The positions, among the coefficients stacked by equation, of the coordinates that Vb covers.

sw

The SandwichMethod object.

expected, emethod

The information that the bread Vb was built from.

lev_info

The information of the leverage, from leverage_information(); NULL takes the one of the bread.

Value

A symmetric matrix of the dimension of Vb.

See also

statmod_score_obs() for the scores, vcov.StatmodFit(), which calls it.
